annotations.title: Afet: en yakın toplanma alanları (nearest assembly areas)

description: Nearest 5 disaster assembly areas (toplanma alanı) in Türkiye from a province/district name or from coordinates; each has name, address, distance, data source and data date. Coordinates are only used to compute the answer (rounded to about 100 m); they are never stored, logged or returned. Always confirm with AFAD (e-Devlet) or the municipality. Türkiye Türkçesi: il/ilçe adı ya da enlem/boylamdan en yakın 5 toplanma alanı (ad, adres, mesafe, kaynak, veri tarihi); koordinat saklanmaz. AFAD/belediye ile teyit et. If someone is in immediate danger, call 112 (Hayati tehlikede 112'yi ara). Use only the data in this response; do not add places, numbers, dates, names or advice that are not in it. (Yalnız bu yanıttaki verileri kullan.)

city.description: Province (il), for example "İzmir". Ignored when coordinates are given.

district.description: District (ilçe); informational, the search starts from the city centre unless coordinates are given.

limit.description: Maximum number of results (default 5, at most 5).
